title: cassnoccurrences: CASSN Occurrence Dataset Pipeline
description: R package that reads conventionally staged Wildlife Insights, NABat or SonoBat, Motus, and California Sentinel Sites for Nature (CASSN) ingest metadata, applies consistent occurrence rules, and writes one standardized comma-separated occurrence dataset with a build receipt.

creators.name: Imperato, John
creators.affiliation: University of California Natural Reserve System, UC Davis
